Message.Name: Last Sale Europe Message
Message.Description: Last Sale Europe Messages are sent when an order on a Cboe order book is executed in whole or in part, or when a reported trade is submitted to Cboe

Field.Name: Trading Date Time
Field.Description: Date and time the trade occured

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: ISIN Code that identifies the financial instrument

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of the trade. This may be zero if the price is pending, as denoted by the “Price Discovery Process” field

Field.Name: Price Currency
Field.Description: ISO 3-letter Currency code

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares executed

Field.Name: Execution Venue
Field.Description: ISO 10383 segment MIC, and SINT for Systematic internalisers, XOFF for OTC trades

Field.Name: Publication Date Time
Field.Description: Date and time the trade was published

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution/trade identifier. Left padded with zeroes.

Field.Name: Transaction Category
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT v3 Level 3.1 “RPRI” = Trade that has Received Price Improvement “TPAC” = Package Trade “XFPH” = Exchange For Physical Trade

Field.Name: Negotiation Flag
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT v3 Level 3.2 “NLIQ” = Negotiated Trade in Liquid Instruments “OILQ” = Negotiated Trade in Illiquid Instruments “PRIC” = Negotiated Trade Subject to Conditions Other Than The Current Market Price “ILQD” = Pre-Trade Transparency Waiver for Illiquid Instrument on an SI “SIZE” = Pre-Trade Transparency Waiver for Above Standard Size on an SI If the Pre-Trade Transparency Waivers of “ILQD” and “SIZE” both apply to the trade, “SIZE” will be published in this field

Field.Name: Agency Cross Trade
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT v3 Level 3.3 “ACTX” = Agency Cross Trade

Field.Name: Modification Indicator
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT v3 Level 3.4 “CANC” = Trade Cancellation “AMND” = Trade Amendment

Field.Name: Benchmark/Reference Indicator
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT v3 Level 3.5 “BENC” = Benchmark Trade “RFPT” = Reference Price Trade

Field.Name: Special Dividend
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT v3 Level 3.6 “SDIV” = Special Dividend Trade

Field.Name: Price Discovery Process
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT v3 Level 3.8 “NPFT” = Non-Price Forming Trade “TNCP” = Trade not Contributing to the Price Discovery Process “PNDG” = Price is Pending

Field.Name: Algorithmic Indicator
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT v3 Level 3.9 “ALGO” = Algorithmic Trade

Field.Name: Post-Trade Deferral Reason
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT v3 Level 4.1 “LRGS” = Deferral for “Large in Scale” “ILQD” = Deferral for “Illiquid Instrument” “SIZE” = Deferral for “Size Specific” If the Post-Trade Deferral Reasons of “ILQD” and “SIZE” or “ILQD” and “LRGS” both apply to the trade, “ILQD” will be published in this field

Field.Name: Duplicative Indicator
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT v3 Level 5 “DUPL” = Duplicative Trade Report

Field.Name: Jurisdiction
Field.Description: Corresponds to venue where the trade was executed “EU” = Trade executed on an EU regulated venue” “UK” = Trade executed on a non-EU regulated venue”

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp

Field.Name: Sequenced Message Type
Field.Description: Alphanumeric
